WHAT YOU CAN DO

Thoughtful tools.
Personal websites.

Wishly brings ready-made designs, visual editing and a straightforward publishing workflow together. The exact sections and interactions available depend on the template you select.

✍️

Visual editing

Select supported text, photos, videos, audio and buttons directly on a template preview. Make changes in context and see them reflected in the page.

🧩

Template-specific structure

Each design has its own sections and supported interactions. Preview a template before choosing it, especially when you need a particular feature.

🖼️

Media tools

Replace supported images, add video or audio and arrange galleries where the design provides them. Check crop, loading and playback before sharing.

🎨

Theme and font settings

Choose a coordinated color palette or a custom HEX color and select a font from the design settings. Preferences are saved for the template being edited.

📱

Phone-friendly workflow

Edit from a phone or computer. Controls support touch as well as a pointer, and you can review the visitor experience at mobile width.

✨

Interactive experiences

Depending on the design, visitors may find reveals, chapters, countdowns, games, music, RSVP or reply forms and other small interactions.

↶

Undo, redo and preview

Use the available history controls to move backward or forward through changes, then switch to Preview to test the visitor journey.

🔗

Publishing and sharing

Publish a page with its own link, then share it through messaging apps or a QR code where supported.

📊

Creator dashboard

Return to your websites from one workspace and review available website status, view information and visitor replies.

Change it.
Make it yours.
✓ Preview before publish

A SIMPLE CREATOR WORKFLOW

Start with a design.
Finish with your story.

Wishly is designed for people who want a personal result without writing code. The editor gives you a visual way to update the parts of a template that can be changed.

  • Browse a design and inspect its preview.
  • Update the supported words and media.
  • Adjust the theme and font for that template.
  • Test the page, publish it and share the link.

GOOD TO KNOW

One template may differ
from another.

A gallery, countdown, music control, RSVP form or reply section is only available when the chosen design supports it. Check the individual template preview and guide to understand what is included.
